cards.ex: I really appreciate Sarah; she's so down to earth and easy to talk to about anything.
cards.exUz: Men Sarohni juda qadrlayman; u juda oddiy va u bilan har qanday narsa haqida gaplashish oson.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqiy, tabiiy va o'zini yuqori tutmaydigan inson.

cards.ex: We got off on the wrong foot initially, but now we're best friends.
cards.exUz: Biz dastlab yomon boshlagan edik, lekin endi eng yaxshi do'stmiz.
cards.term: get off on the wrong foot
cards.uzDef: Munosabatlarni yomon boshlash, birinchi taassurot yomon bo'lishi.

cards.ex: I've always looked up to my older brother for his courage and integrity.
cards.exUz: Men har doim akamning jasorati va halolligi uchun unga havas qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir hurmat qilish, unga qoyil qolish va undan o'rnak olish.

cards.ex: She has a heart of gold and is always willing to help others in need.
cards.exUz: Uning yuragi oltindan va doimo yordamga muhtojlarga yordam berishga tayyor.
cards.uzDef: Juda mehribon, saxiy va yaxshi fe'lli inson.

cards.ex: We're always on the same wavelength; we just understand each other without needing to explain everything.
cards.exUz: Biz doimo bir xil fikrdamiz; biz bir-birimizni hamma narsani tushuntirishga hojat qoldirmay tushunamiz.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrda bo'lish, bir-birini oson tushunish.

cards.ex: Their friendship is as solid as a rock; they've known each other for decades.
cards.exUz: Ularning do'stligi qoya kabi mustahkam; ular o'nlab yillar davomida bir-birlarini bilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Juda ishonchli, kuchli va o'zgarmas bo'lgan do'stlik.

cards.ex: I appreciate that John always speaks his mind, even if it's not what I want to hear.
cards.exUz: Men Jonning doimo o'z fikrini aytishini qadrlayman, hatto bu men eshitmoqchi bo'lgan narsa bo'lmasa ham.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini ochiq va to'g'ri bildirish, o'ylaganingni gapirish.

cards.ex: Don't worry, I'm in your corner no matter what you decide to do.
cards.exUz: Xavotir olma, nima qilishga qaror qilsang ham, men seni qo'llab-quvvatlayman.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir qo'llab-quvvatlash, yordam berish, himoya qilish.

cards.ex: We had a real heart-to-heart about our feelings and it brought us closer.
cards.exUz: Biz o'z his-tuyg'ularimiz haqida chin dildan gaplashdik va bu bizni yaqinlashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Chuqur, samimiy va shaxsiy suhbat.

cards.ex: I'm not sure if he's telling the truth, but I'm willing to give him the benefit of the doubt.
cards.exUz: U rost gapiryaptimi, bilmayman, lekin unga ishonch bildirishga tayyorman.
cards.term: give someone the benefit of the doubt
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir to'g'ri ekanligiga ishonish, shubha qilmaslik.

cards.ex: After her father passed away, her best friend was a pillar of strength for her.
cards.exUz: Otasi vafotidan keyin, uning eng yaxshi do'sti unga tayanch nuqtasi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin paytlarda yordam beradigan, kuch beradigan inson.

cards.ex: I know I can always count on my friends to be there for me when I need them.
cards.exUz: Bilaman, do'stlarimga har doim suyanishim mumkin, ular menga kerak bo'lganda yonimda bo'lishadi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir qiyin paytida yordam berish, qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: We always have each other's backs, no matter what challenges we face.
cards.exUz: Qanday qiyinchiliklarga duch kelmaylik, biz doimo bir-birimizni himoya qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Bir-birini himoya qilish, yordam berish, qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: You can always count on me to be there for you, no matter what.
cards.exUz: Nima bo'lishidan qat'iy nazar, har doim menga ishonishing mumkin, men senga yordam beraman.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir ishonchli deb hisoblash, yordamiga umid qilish.

cards.ex: After their argument, she decided to cut ties with him completely.
cards.exUz: Ular janjallashgandan so'ng, u u bilan aloqani butunlay uzishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan aloqani to'xtatish, munosabatlarni buzish.

cards.ex: He proved to be a friend indeed when he helped me move all my furniture.
cards.exUz: U barcha mebellarimni ko'chirishga yordam berganida, haqiqiy do'st ekanligini isbotladi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin paytda yordam beradigan, chinakam do'st.

cards.ex: We don't always see eye to eye, but we respect each other's opinions.
cards.exUz: Biz har doim bir xil fikrda bo'lmaymiz, lekin bir-birimizning fikrlarini hurmat qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrda bo'lish, kelishmovchiliksiz fikrlash.

cards.ex: She tends to hold a grudge, so it takes her a while to forgive people.
cards.exUz: U xafagarchilikni saqlab yurishga moyil, shuning uchun odamlarni kechirishga vaqt ketadi.
cards.uzDef: Xafagarchilikni uzoq vaqt saqlab yurish, kechira olmaslik.

cards.ex: He's a true-blue friend; you can always rely on him.
cards.exUz: U sodiq do'st; siz har doim unga ishonishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqiy, sodiq va ishonchli do'st.

cards.ex: They've been at odds with each other ever since that argument.
cards.exUz: Ular o'sha bahsdan beri bir-birlari bilan kelishmovchilikda.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan kelishmovchilikda bo'lish, bir fikrga kelmaslik.

cards.ex: Their friendship is built on a strong bond of trust and mutual respect.
cards.exUz: Ularning do'stligi ishonch va o'zaro hurmatning mustahkam rishtasiga asoslangan.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchga asoslangan kuchli munosabatlar.

cards.ex: It's important to forgive and forget if you want to maintain a healthy friendship.
cards.exUz: Sog'lom do'stlikni saqlab qolishni istasangiz, kechirish va unutish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Xafagarchilikni kechirish va o'tmishni unutish.

cards.ex: We've been through so much together; she's definitely a friend for life.
cards.exUz: Biz birgalikda juda ko'p narsalarni boshdan kechirdik; u, albatta, umrlik do'st.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida do'st bo'lib qoladigan inson.

cards.ex: We're ride or die; I know she'll always be there for me, no matter what.
cards.exUz: Biz oxirigacha birgamiz; bilaman, u nima bo'lishidan qat'iy nazar, doimo yonimda bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Har qanday vaziyatda birga bo'lishga tayyor bo'lgan do'st.

cards.ex: I don't want to take sides in their argument; I'm friends with both of them.
cards.exUz: Men ularning bahsida tarafdorlik qilmoqchi emasman; men ularning ikkalasi bilan ham do'stman.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir tarafini olish, kimdir bilan kelishmovchilikda bo'lganlarga qarshi chiqish.

cards.ex: They've been the best of buddies since they were kids.
cards.exUz: Ular bolaligidan beri eng yaqin do'stlar.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaqin va qadrdon do'stlar.

cards.ex: She would bend over backwards for her friends; she's incredibly generous.
cards.exUz: U do'stlari uchun hamma narsani qiladi; u juda saxiy.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir uchun hamma narsani qilish, juda ko'p harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He's always been a shoulder to lean on during difficult times.
cards.exUz: U doimo qiyin paytlarda tayanch do'st bo'lgan.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin paytlarda yordamga tayyor, ishonchli do'st.

cards.ex: They met at the party and got along like a house on fire.
cards.exUz: Ular ziyofatda uchrashishdi va juda yaxshi kelishib ketishdi.
cards.term: get along like a house on fire
cards.uzDef: Tezda do'stlashib, bir-biri bilan yaxshi munosabatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: We're kindred spirits; we have so much in common.
cards.exUz: Biz ruh jihatdan yaqinmiz; bizda juda ko'p umumiy narsalar bor.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil qadriyatlar va manfaatlariga ega bo'lgan insonlar.
